mapper.select: /* SQL ID: com.winter.winter_back.domain.owner.dao.OwnerDao.getOwnerStoreId SQL 명: 사장님 가게 ID 조회 */ SELECT id FROM tb_store WHERE owner_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

/* SQL ID: com.winter.winter_back.domain.owner.dao.OwnerDao.getOwnerStore SQL 명: 사장님 가게 정보와 오늘 주문·매출 현황 */ SELECT s.id AS store_id , s.name , s.description , s.min_order_amount , s.category , s.address , s.latitude , s.longitude , s.phone , (SELECT i.image_url FROM tb_store_image i WHERE i.store_id = s.id ORDER BY i.sort_order LIMIT 1) AS image_url , s.status , s.delivery_time AS wait_minutes , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_order o WHERE o.store_id = s.id AND o.created_datetime >= CURDATE() AND o.status != 'CANCELLED') AS today_order_count , (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) FROM tb_order o WHERE o.store_id = s.id AND o.created_datetime >= CURDATE() AND o.status = 'DELIVERED') AS today_sales , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_order o WHERE o.store_id = s.id AND o.status = 'PENDING') AS new_order_count , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_order o WHERE o.store_id = s.id AND o.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'PREPARING', 'DELIVERING')) AS in_progress_order_count , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_review r WHERE r.store_id = s.id AND r.reply_content IS NULL) AS unanswered_review_count FROM tb_store s WHERE s.id = #{storeId}
mapper.sql: SELECT o.order_id , o.status , o.order_type , o.total_amount , o.payment_method , o.delivery_phone AS contact_phone , o.order_request , (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(m.name, ' x', oi.quantity) ORDER BY oi.order_item_id SEPARATOR ', ') FROM tb_order_items oi JOIN tb_menus m ON m.id = oi.menu_id WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id) AS item_summary , (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) FROM tb_order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id) AS item_count , o.created_datetime AS ordered_at FROM tb_order o

SELECT r.idx AS review_id , r.order_order_id AS order_id , u.name AS user_name , r.rating , r.content , r.images , (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(m.name, ' x', oi.quantity) ORDER BY oi.order_item_id SEPARATOR ', ') FROM tb_order_items oi JOIN tb_menus m ON m.id = oi.menu_id WHERE oi.order_id = r.order_order_id) AS item_summary , r.created_datetime , r.reply_content , r.reply_datetime FROM tb_review r LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.id = r.user_id
mapper.select:
/* SQL ID: com.winter.winter_back.domain.owner.dao.OwnerDao.getOwnerReviewCount SQL 명: 사장님 가게 리뷰 수 */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_review r WHERE r.store_id = #{storeId}
AND r.reply_content IS NULL
/* SQL ID: com.winter.winter_back.domain.owner.dao.OwnerDao.getOwnerOrderCount SQL 명: 사장님 가게 주문 수 */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_order o WHERE o.store_id = #{storeId}

/* SQL ID: com.winter.winter_back.domain.owner.dao.OwnerDao.getOwnerMenuList SQL 명: 사장님 가게 메뉴 목록 */ SELECT m.id AS menu_id , c.name AS category_name , m.name , m.description , m.price , m.image_url , m.is_sold_out FROM tb_menus m LEFT JOIN tb_menu_category c ON c.id = m.category_id WHERE m.store_id = #{storeId} AND m.is_active = 1 ORDER BY c.sort_order, m.sort_order, m.id

/* SQL ID: com.winter.winter_back.domain.owner.dao.OwnerDao.getOwnerMenu SQL 명: 사장님 가게 메뉴 단건 */ SELECT m.id AS menu_id , c.name AS category_name , m.name , m.description , m.price , m.image_url , m.is_sold_out FROM tb_menus m LEFT JOIN tb_menu_category c ON c.id = m.category_id WHERE m.store_id = #{storeId} AND m.id = #{menuId} AND m.is_active = 1

/* SQL ID: com.winter.winter_back.domain.owner.dao.OwnerDao.getMenuCategoryId SQL 명: 메뉴 카테고리 ID 조회 */ SELECT id FROM tb_menu_category WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND name = #{name} AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: /* SQL ID: com.winter.winter_back.domain.owner.dao.OwnerDao.regStore SQL 명: 가게 등록 */ INSERT INTO tb_store (name, category, description, phone, address, latitude, longitude, status, min_order_amount, delivery_fee, delivery_time, owner_id) VALUES (#{name}, #{category}, #{description}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, 'CLOSED', #{minOrderAmount}, 0, #{waitMinutes}, #{ownerId})
mapper.select: /* SQL ID: com.winter.winter_back.domain.owner.dao.OwnerDao.getStoreImageUrls SQL 명: 가게 사진 주소 조회 */ SELECT image_url FROM tb_store_image WHERE store_id = #{storeId}
mapper.insert: /* SQL ID: com.winter.winter_back.domain.owner.dao.OwnerDao.regStoreImage SQL 명: 가게 대표 사진 등록 */ INSERT INTO tb_store_image (store_id, image_url, sort_order) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{imageUrl}, 0)

/* SQL ID: com.winter.winter_back.domain.owner.dao.OwnerDao.regStoreCategory SQL 명: 가게 간식 종류 등록 */ INSERT INTO tb_store_category (store_id, category_code, category_name) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{categoryCode}, #{categoryName})
mapper.select: /* SQL ID: com.winter.winter_back.domain.owner.dao.OwnerDao.getStoreHours SQL 명: 가게 요일별 영업시간 조회 */ SELECT day_of_week , DATE_FORMAT(open_time, '%H:%i') AS open_time , DATE_FORMAT(close_time, '%H:%i') AS close_time , is_holiday FROM tb_store_hours WHERE store_id = #{storeId}
mapper.insert: /* SQL ID: com.winter.winter_back.domain.owner.dao.OwnerDao.mergeStoreHours SQL 명: 가게 요일 영업시간 추가·수정 */ INSERT INTO tb_store_hours (store_id, day_of_week, open_time, close_time, is_holiday) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{day.dayOfWeek}, #{day.openTime}, #{day.closeTime}, #{day.isHoliday}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE open_time = VALUES(open_time) , close_time = VALUES(close_time) , is_holiday = VALUES(is_holiday)
mapper.select: /* SQL ID: com.winter.winter_back.domain.owner.dao.OwnerDao.getDailySales SQL 명: 사장님 가게 날짜별 매출 */ SELECT DATE(o.created_datetime) AS sales_date , SUM(o.total_amount) AS sales , COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM tb_order o WHERE o.store_id = #{storeId} AND o.status = 'DELIVERED' AND o.created_datetime >= #{fromDate} AND o.created_datetime < DATE_ADD(#{toDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(o.created_datetime) ORDER BY sales_date

/* SQL ID: com.winter.winter_back.domain.owner.dao.OwnerDao.getTopMenus SQL 명: 사장님 가게 인기 메뉴 */ SELECT m.name AS menu_name , SUM(oi.quantity) AS quantity , SUM(oi.price * oi.quantity) AS sales FROM tb_order o JOIN tb_order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN tb_menus m ON m.id = oi.menu_id WHERE o.store_id = #{storeId} AND o.status = 'DELIVERED' AND o.created_datetime >= #{fromDate} AND o.created_datetime < DATE_ADD(#{toDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY m.id, m.name ORDER BY quantity DESC, sales DESC, m.id LIMIT #{limit}
